entities.summary: Fredrik Olofsson is a Swedish professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing under contract with Rögle BK of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). He was selected by Chicago Blackhawks in the fourth-round, 98th overall, of the 2014 NHL Entry Draft.
